data.text: Practical inquiry and scientific discovery are central to learning at The VIDYA School. We maintain advanced, fully compliant laboratories.

items.title: Physics Laboratory
items.description: Equipped with precision optical benches, electronic meters, resonance apparatus, and mechanics kits meeting CBSE practical specifications.

items.title: Chemistry Laboratory
items.description: Features modern fume hoods, chemical storage, digital titration instruments, fire retardant benches, and safety showers.

items.title: Biology Laboratory
items.description: High-powered binocular microscopes, extensive human anatomy models, botanical specimens, and ecological testing kits.

items.title: Computer & IT Center
items.description: High-speed networked terminals, fiber-optic internet, licensed programming environments, and digital audio-visual suites.
